title: Child Birthday Party with Cake & Gifts, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1960s black-and-white square snapshot capturing a toddler's birthday celebration. The young child sits at the head of a table surrounded by family, holding an illustrated bunny greeting card next to a large gift box adorned with a ribbon. To the left sits a birthday cake with candles ready to be lit, along with vintage glassware. Two women in iconic 1960s sleeveless shift dresses and classic bouffant hairstyles look on fondly alongside a young boy.
